name: GET /api/leadflow/kpi-definitions/:metric_key - the version history
description:
Every version of one definition, newest first (44fa2588-4db3-48f4-a653-2c0a970f94fc#AC3). The history is the artifact that makes a changed chart explainable: a reader who sees a series jump in March can find that the denominator changed on the 12th, who changed it and why they said they did. A registry that keeps only the current version answers "what does this mean today" and leaves every historical comparison silently wrong.

QA: reads the metric registered earlier in the chain.

testCases.name: The current version and its full history are returned
NEGATIVE: a metric nobody ever registered
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: No definition has ever been registered for that metric
errorCases.when: no version of that metric key exists.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
